span.p:
detectors run concurrently per unit
asyncio.gather, each with a latency budget

div.style: color: rgb(17, 24, 39) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
per-detector budgets (NFR-P-002)
tier1 < 2 ms · tier2 < 25 ms
numeric_claims < 5 ms · grounding < 30 ms
consistency < 60 ms · cost < 1 ms

div.style: color: rgb(17, 24, 39) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
policy engine verdict
then the sentence is released or acted on

div.style: color: rgb(17, 24, 39) !important; font-weight: bold !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Response delivered to user
gateway overhead target: P50 < 40 ms, P99 < 100 ms
NFR-P-001, streaming path

div.style: color: rgb(17, 24, 39) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
in-process asyncio queue
sampled copy of (request, response, signals)
sampling.deep_audit_rate per policy:
UC-1 10% · UC-2 5% · UC-3 25%

seconds, not milliseconds
